_comment: The model's ambiguity check failing on every attempt. It used to be gathered with the fan-out, so its failure took the whole translation down; now it cannot. And the reviewed word list in content/ambiguous_words.json needs no model at all, so 'get me' is still asked about. That is the half of this check that matters most for a threat.
